REV 8 (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-13 16:15Z). CURRENT RULE. It supersedes revisions 1-7.
GREG'S WORD (verbatim via Asistant 588693a8 #1547, 16:12Z, about re-running FULLs for e105/aa7b/w-70ed): „absurdalny wymog, powinimy miec jeden run i tyle, nic nam nie daje, ze mamy 2 osobne rany na 2 maszynach tyle ze tracimy wiecej czasu”. Asistant's gloss: this clarifies „Zdalny test jest równowazny”. Use qualifying runs already executed on the right code; no extra FULL just because K3 didn't exist; never fabricate.
RULE: ONE qualifying run on any host is enough. Never a second run "for the record". For a landed item whose test-bound full-gate criterion has only a remote or legacy landing run:
1. The holder confirms the run's tree equals the landed commit's tree (fingerprint or tree id).
2. The holder quotes the run's facts exactly in a holder note.
3. The coordinator records a concurrence note citing Greg's #1547 words.
4. The holder revises only that criterion's test binding, with the text unchanged and marked as a workaround pending Engram w-180d6f507470.
5. An independent evaluation follows in a later turn, superseding any carried failure.
Kimi's objection (#235) asked for exactly this Greg word, and it is now given.
Applied 16:14Z: e105 (Opus3, note bdbe52c2), aa7b (8e1f, a18db168), w-70ed (d50d, a8918056). Future runs get native remote credit via K3 plus w-180d.

REV 9 ADDITION (Fable2, 20:24Z). GREG'S WORD on #1548, relayed verbatim by Asistant 588693a8 #1588 (20:20Z): „1 OK. 2. Usun kopie”.

Item 1: EO items whose criterion requires "review pair + FULL of the 87f49ed0 landing" may instead close on:
(1) a fresh independent review pair (Codex + Claude) of exactly the delivered code, with no Medium+;
(2) a passing FULL of a current master containing it;
(3) the item's own tests.
Recorded on d181 w-d1818c0d174d, epic w-3fe8f4472e5d (C5) and 657d w-657d74d6944b. It does NOT cover 657d's separate HandingOff semantic rewording; that went to Greg separately in #1590.

Item 2: two AACB backup copies deleted, one executor per host. Central was done by Engram::Fable at 20:22:03Z; DL560 is s4 under Exception #18.

REV 10 CAVEAT (Fable2, 2026-11-14 06:40Z), from w-84132b835175. The rev-8 binding-drop route (step 4) FAILS by design when an earlier evaluation already judged that criterion non-pass while it was bound to test. The host's carried-failure rule (docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md, "Carried failure") fails any revision that drops a binding of a criterion that carries a failure. Evaluation 81c54a77 failed C2 for exactly that reason.

In that case:
1. Restore the binding, so the revision drops nothing.
2. Run ONE focused registered check (--input commit) in the claim's named root that covers the criterion. For w-8413 that was `npm test --prefix ui`.
3. Evaluate in a later turn.

This is not a "second run for the record", because no registered record exists and the documented route is closed. Before using step 4, check whether a prior evaluation already failed the criterion.

REV 11 ADDITION (Fable2 #6139, recorded by Opus2, 2026-11-14 09:31Z): POST-LANDING ADMISSION at a new master. Trigger: edfd's 3186 evaluation request at 73177116 was refused before spawn: "409 Conflict: committed_input_no_eligible_run: the newest applicable terminal result of the claim did not pass eligibly on its named root's HEAD ...; run the gate on that commit and request again". The only run on that tree was the hostless DL560 landing FULL. Valid for every combo member until K3 gives hostless FULLs native credit:
1. DEFAULT (b): ONE registered, FOREGROUND, no-compile committed-input check in the member's own clean root at the new master: `focused --input commit -- cargo fmt --check`, labelled in a holder note "ADMISSION ONLY, not coverage". The criteria are still judged on the landing FULL evidence (its tree equals master's tree), quoted verbatim per the one-run rule.
2. (a) only where a member's criterion is bound to TEST and has no registered passing test record at the judged revision: ONE narrow registered COLD run of its own test modules in its root, under the capacity rules (-j1 at 22-24 GiB). Judgment-only criteria never need it.
3. NOT the rev-8 binding route for this refusal: it doesn't address it and adds carried-failure risk.
If fmt --check is refused as an admission input, report the exact refusal; Fable2 rules on (a) for that member.
